log:
=============================================
  Hayami Amamiya (ISTP)
  vs
  Mica Dwyer (ENTP)
=============================================

  HP: Hayami 85 | Mica 85

--- Round 1 ---
Hayami says nothing and hits Mica with Elemental Mastery from a direction that made no sense.
Mica takes the hit but pushes forward. (-36.7 HP)
HP: Hayami 85 | Mica 48.3

Mica adapts their Adaptive Mutation into a counter nobody expected, including them.
The momentum has shifted. Hayami needs to turn this around. Hayami files it away without expression. (-47.2 HP)
HP: Hayami 37.8 | Mica 48.3

--- Round 2 ---
Hayami reads the physics of the fight and applies Elemental Mastery exactly where it hurts most.
Mica is running on empty. One more hit ends this. (-28.5 HP)
HP: Hayami 37.8 | Mica 19.8

Mica pivots completely mid-attack and catches Hayami off guard with Adaptive Mutation.
Mica smells blood. Hayami is almost done. Hayami files it away without expression. (-37.5 HP)
HP: Hayami 0.3 | Mica 19.8

--- Round 3 ---
Hayami finds the single most efficient angle and deploys Elemental Mastery without wasted motion.
Mica is running on empty. One more hit ends this. (-25.7 HP)
HP: Hayami 0.3 | Mica 0

=============================================
WINNER: Hayami Amamiya!
Hayami stands victorious.
